compiled_state.title: UPDATE tests: record-review.sh severity-based STATUS, no score= in review-status
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD2: record-review.sh derives STATUS=failed when any finding has severity critical, important, or fragile, and STATUS=passed when all findings are minor or findings array is empty
- DD3: The review-status file contains no score= line
- DD4: A minor finding whose description text contains the word 'critical' or 'important' does not cause STATUS=failed

## What to modify
Update tests/hooks/test-record-review.sh, tests/hooks/test-record-review-crossval.sh, and tests/hooks/test-record-review-attest.sh to assert the new severity-based behavior BEFORE record-review.sh is updated:

**test-record-review.sh changes:**
1. Replace all 3-key fixtures {scores:{...},findings:[...],summary:"..."} with 2-key {findings:[...],summary:"..."}
2. RENAME (or replace) test_record_review_exits_nonzero_on_missing_scores → test_record_review_accepts_two_key_schema: assert exit 0 for {findings:[],summary:"..."} (currently this test expects exit != 0)
3. Remove test_record_review_exits_nonzero_on_score_out_of_range (scores no longer validated)
4. ADD test_severity_critical_produces_failed_status: given {findings:[{severity:critical,category:correctness,file:foo.sh,description:"..."}],summary:"..."}, assert review-status line 1 = "failed"
5. ADD test_severity_important_produces_failed_status: same with severity=important
6. ADD test_severity_fragile_produces_failed_status: same with severity=fragile
7. ADD test_severity_minor_produces_passed_status: given {findings:[{severity:minor,...}],summary:"..."}, assert review-status line 1 = "passed"
8. ADD test_empty_findings_produces_passed_status: given {findings:[],summary:"..."}, assert review-status line 1 = "passed"
9. ADD test_minor_with_critical_in_description_produces_passed_status: given finding with severity=minor,description="critical issue found", assert STATUS=passed (text-based blocking is prohibited)
10. ADD test_review_status_has_no_score_line: assert grep -v '^score=' review-status (no score= line written)

**test-record-review-crossval.sh changes:**
- Remove all tests that verify score-severity cross-validation (currently they check that critical finding + score > 2 = error)
- Replace with test_no_score_crossval_required: assert that a finding with severity=critical and no scores key passes validation (exits 0)

**test-record-review-attest.sh changes:**
- Remove test that asserts --attest fails when source review-status is missing score= field
- Update all fixtures to use 2-key schema
- Add test: --attest with a review-status that has no score= line succeeds

## Given/When/Then
Given: A reviewer-findings.json with a finding of severity=critical and no scores key
When: record-review.sh --reviewer-hash <hash> runs
Then: exits 0, review-status line 1 = "failed", no score= line in review-status

## RED markers required
Add .test-index entries after modifying tests (new test function names are non-standard and require explicit mapping):
- .test-index: tests/hooks/test-record-review.sh [test_severity_critical_produces_failed_status]
- .test-index: tests/hooks/test-record-review.sh [test_severity_important_produces_failed_status]
- .test-index: tests/hooks/test-record-review.sh [test_severity_fragile_produces_failed_status]
- .test-index: tests/hooks/test-record-review.sh [test_severity_minor_produces_passed_status]
- .test-index: tests/hooks/test-record-review.sh [test_empty_findings_produces_passed_status]
- .test-index: tests/hooks/test-record-review.sh [test_minor_with_critical_in_description_produces_passed_status]
- .test-index: tests/hooks/test-record-review.sh [test_review_status_has_no_score_line]

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Tests pass when run: bash tests/hooks/test-record-review.sh
  Verify: bash tests/hooks/test-record-review.sh
- [ ] test_severity_critical_produces_failed_status exists in test-record-review.sh
  Verify: grep -q 'test_severity_critical_produces_failed_status' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/hooks/test-record-review.sh
- [ ] test_review_status_has_no_score_line exists in test-record-review.sh
  Verify: grep -q 'test_review_status_has_no_score_line' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/hooks/test-record-review.sh
- [ ] test_minor_with_critical_in_description_produces_passed_status exists
  Verify: grep -q 'test_minor_with_critical_in_description_produces_passed_status' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/hooks/test-record-review.sh
- [ ] .test-index contains RED markers for all new test function names
  Verify: grep -q 'test_severity_critical_produces_failed_status' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] test-record-review-crossval.sh is updated (no score cross-val tests)
  Verify: bash tests/hooks/test-record-review-crossval.sh
- [ ] test-record-review-attest.sh is updated (no score= requirement)
  Verify: bash tests/hooks/test-record-review-attest.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
